entries.claim: Task 5 files a snag internal to one design as 'internal to <design>' with no contracts.md row and no added row. That leaves CONTEXT AC1 and ROADMAP Phase 1 criterion 1 ('cites an entry there or adds one') unmet. The plan settles a conflict between two locked CONTEXT items (AC1 against D-01's two-design rule) on its own, and no task sends that conflict to the owner.
entries.failure_scenario: Pass 1 returns a token-waste snag confined to landing-design.md (CLAUDE.md 1.3, which Task 4's brief asks for). Task 5 groups it as 'internal to landing-design' and its Verify accepts that ('or states it is internal to one design'). After Plan 3, a check of AC1 ('every finding in REVIEW-*.md cites a contracts.md entry') finds the finding with no entry, so AC1 fails and the phase cannot close on its acceptance criteria. No ruling or D-NN line ever authorised the exemption, and Plan 3 Task 1 only routes G-NN groups, not this criterion conflict.
